POST /Packages/Installed/{name}.classification: accepted-divergence: repository install of WASM plugins is real (2026-08-14: ABI gate → HTTPS-per-hop download → streamed size cap → sha256/md5 verify → component+identity validation → guid-squat refusal → atomic stage → restart-required; admin-only; end-to-end server test). Divergence vs Jellyfin: the install is SYNCHRONOUS — none of the PackageInstalling/Completed/Failed/Cancelled WebSocket messages are emitted (no dashboard progress; a slow repo holds the POST open), and the plugin appears in /Plugins only after the activating restart. Async install + Package* push is the recorded follow-up (WebSocket-push backlog).

DELETE /Packages/Installing/{packageId}.classification: accepted-divergence: always 404 — installs are synchronous, so no tracked installation exists to cancel (Jellyfin tracks async installs). Admin-only.

GET /Packages/{name}.classification: instance: resolves a package by name/assemblyGuid from the aggregated repository catalog — catalog content is repository-config-specific, and the harness instances configure none, so there is no package to diff. Route verified 2026-08-14 by unit + server HTTP tests.

DELETE /Plugins/{pluginId}.classification: accepted-divergence: real uninstall for a staged WASM plugin (file + config + enabled override removed, restart-required); a compiled-in extension honestly rejects with 400 where Jellyfin can uninstall any plugin. Admin-only.

GET /Plugins/{pluginId}/Configuration.classification: instance: the two servers share no plugin id (Ferrofin ships compiled-in extensions + WASM plugins; stock Jellyfin ships neither), so there is no config to fetch on both sides. Real read (stored values overlaid on defaults, C# partial-deserialize semantics); verified 2026-08-14 by unit + handler tests.

POST /Plugins/{pluginId}/Configuration.classification: instance: no shared plugin id across the two servers, so no config write to diff. Real write (JSON-validated, persisted; admin-only — a WASM plugin's config is guest input); verified 2026-08-14 by unit + handler tests incl. 403.

POST /Plugins/{pluginId}/Manifest.classification: instance: no shared plugin id across the two servers, so no manifest to fetch on both sides. Real read (GetPluginManifest port); verified 2026-08-14 by handler tests.

DELETE /Plugins/{pluginId}/{version}.classification: accepted-divergence: real uninstall for a staged WASM plugin (restart-required); a compiled-in extension honestly rejects with 400 where Jellyfin can uninstall any plugin. Admin-only.

POST /Plugins/{pluginId}/{version}/Disab.classification: accepted-divergence: real enabled-flag toggle (admin-only), but a freshly repository-installed WASM plugin 404s until its activating restart (not in the registry until the boot that loads it) while Jellyfin already lists it restart-pending. Cosmetic pre-restart window.

GET /Studios/{name}.classification: accepted-divergence: Ferrofin does not lazily CREATE a by-name item on a GET (Jellyfin's GetItemByName writes a row as a read side-effect → J=200 for an absent studio). Ferrofin returns the item if it exists (200, BaseItemDto) else 404 — a GET with no filesystem write. Verified live 2026-08-11: existing→200, absent→404.

GET /Genres/{genreName}.classification: accepted-divergence: same no-lazy-create-on-GET family as /Studios/{name}. Existing genre→200 BaseItemDto (both servers), absent→Ferrofin 404 vs Jellyfin auto-created 200. Shape verified.

GET /Persons/{name}.classification: accepted-divergence: same no-lazy-create-on-GET family as /Studios/{name}. Existing person→200 BaseItemDto, absent→404 (both servers 404 in the harness run). Shape verified.
